sentences.en: I'm a novice at programming, but I learn quickly.
sentences.zh: 我编程还是新手，但学得快。

sentences.en: When it comes to love, women are experts and men eternal novices.
sentences.zh: 说到爱情，女人是专家，男人永远都是新手。

sentences.en: I'm a novice at this kind of work.
sentences.zh: 我对这种工作还是个新手。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：nov（新的）+ice（表人）→新手
